sensor_and_offline_tool_preservation: All inventoried files unchanged by SHA-256; sensor/offline folders lack valid Git worktrees.
analysis_execution: Pure existing StairEvidenceTracker evaluated first two samples of each recorded LiDAR CSV; all 3 reproduce the legacy odometry sample-gap fault.

findings.evidence: OBSERVED code; user-reported slip; UNVERIFIED physical reproduction/mitigation

cold_read.assessment: Roadmap was understandable; required explicit per-run anchor, degraded-command policy, and physical/timing acceptance limits.
applied_fixes: Tracking-state-to-command table added; verified loss response required before physical control.
External measurement uncertainty, command-gap targets, and bounded completion/recovery rules added.

fact_check.repository: Claims checked against installed local code and configs; input mismatch reproduced using the existing class.
fact_check.upstream: rospy Timer implementation checked in /opt/ros/noetic/lib/python3/dist-packages/rospy/timer.py; no deadline guarantee inferred.
fact_check.physical: Zero-command instability reported by user; geometry values found in existing record. Physical reproduction, profile association, command response and live throughput remain UNVERIFIED.

risks: Same known bags are regression material, not holdout.
Internal GICP/gyro consistency is not independent physical ground truth.
Replaying recorded sensors does not evaluate the motion caused by newly computed control commands.
validation_independence.fix: Numerical equivalence reported separately; external surveyed/video reference and a later evaluation run required for physical outcomes.

consistency_review.correction: HOLD continues to test existing NAV reuse first; dedicated controller conditional. Historical broad bridge/coordinator proposal not treated as current mandate.
consistency_review.consolidation: Read-only audit; prior artifacts not changed.

confirmed_user_input: Earlier premature FINAL_ARRIVAL referred only to the RViz annotation.
plan_limits: This plan can precede M0/M1 work. Physical control depends on unresolved commissioning inputs and acceptance criteria; no claim of full audit or live validation completion.

confirmed_user_inputs.execution_host: Existing control workstation; same launch as mission_manager/multifloor_manager/move_base. Mini PC owns sensor stack.
confirmed_user_inputs.zero_command: User reports sliding or tilting while stair mode remains enabled and zero commands are sent; accepted design condition, not independently reproduced.
confirmed_user_inputs.geometry: Existing 5F/RF commissioning record contains 1.23m width, 2.70m x 1.48m landing, 10+9+2 exit steps. Scope must not silently transfer to 3F/4F.

remaining_engineering_verification: Floor-specific geometry association and original records for tread/riser dimensions
Dynamic robot support envelope and LiDAR mounting x/y
Firmware posture response and supported loss response including command watchdog
Closed-loop drift correction on supported landing; no arbitrary backward stair-step correction
Combined workload latency on existing control workstation
revision_changes: Fixed deployment host to existing workstation
Recovered existing geometry with floor/direction provenance
Removed zero-hold candidate and unconditional fade-to-zero recovery
Added bounded longitudinal/landing correction proposal and explicit lower-level posture limitation
Explicitly kept transport watchdog; zero output not counted as safe support
M4 protected commissioning separates response identification from unattended control acceptance

revision_sources.read_scope: 208-282 including command watchdog and mode requests

revision_cold_read.read_extent: All 292 lines of pre-final revision; section 5-6 reread after initial output truncation
revision_cold_read.verdict: Stands alone as a plan with two command-contract gaps
applied_fixes: Exhaustive ordered handling for accepted-but-old scans, missing scans and expiration equality
First-stage termination/cancellation ownership explicitly separated from later long-duration HOLD integration

revision_skill_checks.factchk: Repository launch/transport code and recorded geometry directly checked; user report distinguished from physical reproduction
revision_skill_checks.mandela: No new measured performance claimed; proposed control formulas require independent physical validation; retained known-bag/closed-loop distinction
revision_skill_checks.ssotize: Audit-only cross-check with baseline and minimal plan; no edits to historical sources
revision_skill_checks.re0: Obsolete host/zero questions and fade-to-zero policy replaced in canonical plan
